notes.title: Update No. 5
notes.notes:
[p]Welcome back, hoteliers!   It's been a week since the New York Update launched, we hope you've all been enjoying it, we've seen some fantastic skyscrapers so far! This update brings a bit more polish to some of the new things introduced and squashes a few small bugs as well.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/6892de1bdeff6958af1038bea998f5ecca69c7b6.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Style Swapping for Placed Items[/b]
You can now change the look of items [i]after[/i] they’ve been placed! Available colours depend on each item, so go ahead, give that chair a makeover without having to call the construction workers in![/p][/*][*][p][b]Room Cost Reservation[/b]
Planning a room copy? The total cost is now reserved upfront on placement. If you don’t have the funds, you won’t be able to place it so budget accordingly![/p][/*][*][p][b]Room Mirroring[/b]
Flip it to fit it! You can now mirror copied rooms along the [b]X[/b] and [b]Y[/b] axes. Default hotkeys: N (X-axis) and M (Y-axis).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smart Temperature Overlay[/b]
Placing temperature-adjusting items? The temperature overlay will automatically appear, helping you visualize your climate control in real-time.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Instant Clean-up Bug Squashed[/b]
Laundry and dirty dishes will no longer magically clean themselves the moment appliances kick in.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Guest Privacy Patch[/b]
Addressed an issue where guest privacy mode wasn’t behaving correctly. Your guests can rest easy now.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Roof Spawning Fix[/b] 
Laundry and litter should no longer mysteriously appear on the roof! Sorry, the party is over! 🤣[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI & Localization Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Main Menu Glow-Up[/b]
Weekly challenge winners images have been updated![/p][/*][*][p][b]German Localization[/b]
Refined translations and improved clarity.[/p][/*][/list][p]Ready to jump in and explore the changes? Let us know what you think, and keep the feedback coming. Happy building! [/p]

notes.title: Bye Bye lazy cleaners - Hotfix No. 2 Incoming!
notes.notes:
Hey again hoteliers!

We’ve just rolled out a new update to Hotel Architect with a focus on polish, bug fixes, and quality-of-life improvements. Here’s what’s new:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/dcaa9e6f85f39d98d29187d949c74c18bac2e6d8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Gameplay Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Guests now correctly order bar refreshments (including sandwiches, popcorn, espresso, tea, and ice cream).
[*] Special room amenities (mini bar, safe, ironing board, vanity) are now fully functional and used as intended!
[*] Cleaners will now mop all tile types as expected - so no more untouched spots or missed tiles!
[*] Laundry and litter will no longer be left behind due to pickup issues.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Resolved a lag spike caused by multiple inputs during a paused state.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause traffic jams.
[*] Addressed a rare issue preventing save files from loading properly.
[*] Corrected localized text overflow in the settings menu.
[*] Disabling bedrooms no longer kicks guests out; it simply stops new bookings.
[/list]
[h2]Localization[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated several in-game text translations for clarity and accuracy.
[/list]
And that's not all, but we won't bore you with the other bits as they're pretty small!

Thank you for continuing to play and we hope you're all enjoying yourselves! Your feedback keeps us improving and we're taking as much as possible on board!

— The Hotel Architect Team

notes.title: First Hotfix Now Live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/04128f84f4df0fc18d9d344ca9fe81616bd7d8f7.jpg[/img]

We’re so happy to see so many aspiring hoteliers diving into Hotel Architect since our Early Access launch! We'd like to say a massive thank you, your feedback has been invaluable, and we're excited to roll out our first official patch to polish the experience and build a stronger foundation for your dream resorts. 

[h2]Here’s what’s new in this update:[/h2]
✨ Quality of Life Improvements [list]
[*] Cleaning staff just got smarter! We’ve improved cleaning task priorities to ensure a more efficient, guest-friendly hotel.
[*] Added tooltips to guest type icons and required items in the Restaurant and Bar menus for better clarity.
[/list]🐛 Bug Fixes [list]
[*] Squashed a crash bug triggered by deleting a custom-made character.
[*] Resolved an issue with the "Overall Review Score" objectives.
[*] Temperature now impacts staff as originally intended!
[/list]🧠 Gameplay Enhancements [list]
[*] Queue timers added for guests waiting in Reception, Restaurant, and Bar areas, helping you manage flow and service.
[*] UI interactions are now blocked when intro or critic review popups appear, keeping the experience smooth and focused.
[*] Character voices have been toned down with decreased radius and volume!
[/list]🌍 Other Updates [list]
[*] Localization tweaks in the keybinding settings.
[*] Updated community highlight links in the main menu.
[*] Officially marked as Steam Deck playable - build your hotel empire on the go!
[/list]

Also, before we go, we're hosting a reddit AMA on May 29th! You can leave your questions [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/IAmA/comments/1ktn2zw/were_pathos_interactive_an_indie_game_dev_team/?sort=top]here![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/cb5a4caf3fdc2af7d0d559391ed38ce8be8fa913.jpg[/img]

This is just the beginning, and there’s a lot more to come. Keep the feedback coming, and thank you for being part of the Hotel Architect community. Happy building!

– The Hotel Architect Dev Team

notes.title: Release Date Announced & The Final Playtest Begins!
notes.notes:
The wait is nearly over! After lots of trying to hold the secret in, we can't anymore! 

We’re thrilled to announce that Hotel Architect will officially open it's doors to early access on May 20th!

This marks a huge milestone for our team and our community, and we couldn’t have done it without your continued support, feedback, and passion for building the hotels of your dreams!

Check out our release date trailer here:
[previewyoutube=tSDVDdtusZ8;full][/previewyoutube]

But before we roll out the red carpet, we have one final event...

[h2]The Final Is Playtest Now Live![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/9ec50e4699beb542602934ae58e05b89217ea518.jpg[/img]

Starting today, our final community playtest is underway - This is your last chance to get a sneak peek at Hotel Architect before early access launch!

If you’ve signed up for the playtest, check your inbox for access instructions. If not, there’s still time to join! Head over to our steam page and request access now.

We’ll be gathering feedback, monitoring performance, and making final adjustments over the next few days so don’t be shy about sharing your thoughts with us in Discord, Steam forums or on social media!

[h2]What’s New in the Final Playtest?[/h2]
The playtest includes: [list]
[*] Gothenburg and Paris (no Santorini this time!)
[*] Two New Guest types - Upper Crust and Business People
[*] Two New Zones - Spa and Conference Room
[*] Character Creator
[*] Photo Mode
[*] Balance tweaks and performance improvements
[*] A new critic review screen with more details
[*] Assignable task types for staff
[/list]

Whether you’re returning for another stay or checking in for the first time, this is Hotel Architect at its biggest and best yet and we can't wait for you to try out early access!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/d652b73c18c114ca6502684b2d4a06911e5bf2db.png[/img]

[h2]Save the Date![/h2]

Mark your calendars for May 20th! 

We’ll be celebrating launch day with streams, giveaways, and some surprise announcements. Make sure you’re following us on social media and join the Discord so you don’t miss a thing.

Thank you for being part of this journey. We can’t wait to see the incredible hotels you’ll create.

— The Hotel Architect Team
